I don't know if I'd call it nervous. I mean, I guess I don't really feel on edge for no reason. Usually if I'm on edge, there's a reason, like when my boss is watching me thread a pipe. Threading machines can be so finicky, especially the older ones. We have this one Rigid machine at the shop that always jams if you don't oil it right, and the oil smells terrible, it gets all over your clothes and you can't wash it out. I tried soaking my work shirts in vinegar once because my mom said it helps with grease, but it just made me smell like a salad dressing for a week. But yeah, no, I don't think I feel nervous out of nowhere. Just, you know, the normal stuff.\n\nDoctor: Do you often feel sad or empty inside?\n\nPatient: Sad or empty? No, I don't think so. Soldering is actually really tricky, you have to get the copper pipe just hot enough to draw the solder in, but if you overheat it, the flux burns and it won't seal right. I feel like we're just going in circles here. I mean, I don't know about pretending to be someone else with friends or dating or whatever.
